data.summary: The brief asks for a ring of slim wings around a large green courtyard garden, with pitched roofs, oriented towards the sun. Daylight and open garden space matter most, while unit count and size are not set.
unclear: The brief does not say how many homes are wanted or how large they should be.
Five storeys together with a pitched roof may be tall for the neighbours, and the gutter height limit is unknown.
A large courtyard together with a full ring of wings may conflict with the coverage and floor area limits, and a ring may not fit the buildable area.
Turned towards the sun is not tied to a compass direction, so it is unclear which side should open up.
